enabled.description: Set false to turn every deadline off. The gate is auto-activated by nexus.tool.catalog, so this (or default_timeout: 0) is the opt-out.

default_timeout.description: Default per-call timeout as a Go duration string (e.g. '30s', '10m'). Applied when no per_tool key, built-in exemption or awaits_human-tagged tool matches. '0s' means no default deadline.

per_tool.description: Per-tool overrides keyed by tool name. Values are Go duration strings. Keys may be exact names ('web_fetch') or glob patterns matched via path.Match ('mcp.*'). '0s' means no deadline for that tool. Resolution: exact key wins; among glob matches the longest pattern wins; user keys are consulted before the built-in exemptions (ask_user, delegate, spawn_*, delegate_a2a_*, delegate_agui_* = no deadline) and before tools tagged awaits_human (no deadline); otherwise default_timeout applies.
